entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A powerful wizard and illusionist pit champion from Dominaria who gained the power to create real things; consumed by a death wurm and later possessed by Lowallyn.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Ixidor's love and partner in the pit fights, killed by Phage.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Killed Nivea; a dream version tore Ixidor's arm off.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Organization running pit fights in Aphetto, to whom Ixidor owed debts.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: City where the Cabal pit fights were held.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Leader of the army Ixidor created to wage war on the Cabal.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: A numena reincarnated within Ixidor who later possessed him and was killed by Karona.

entities.name: Death wurm
entities.description: Creature representing Nivea's death that consumed Ixidor.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Decided to kill Karona and freed Ixidor from the death wurm.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Rose to immense power after her rebirth and killed Lowallyn in the final battle.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: Where Kamahl found the death wurm.

entities.name: Unmen
entities.description: Silhouettes of Ixidor that were living portals to parts of his kingdom.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War ended in the final battle where Karona killed Lowallyn.

events.summary: Ixidor and Nivea make a living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights in Aphetto.
events.quote: he partnered with his love Nivea to make their living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights

events.summary: Phage kills Nivea, and Ixidor loses his fame and fortune.
events.quote: Ixidor lost his fame and fortune after Nivea was killed by Phage

events.summary: Ixidor is banished to a desert for failing to pay his debts and discovers he can create real things.
events.quote: There, he discovered his powers to create real things instead of just illusions.

events.summary: Ixidor creates an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal in revenge.
events.quote: He also created an army led by Akroma to wage war on the Cabal

events.summary: The Cabal attacks Ixidor's fortress and he is consumed by a deathwurm representing Nivea's death.
events.quote: Ixidor was consumed by a deathwurm representing Nivea's death

events.summary: Akroma finds Ixidor living in the wurm, worshipping an image of Nivea; he restores Akroma but refuses to return.
events.quote: He restored Akroma but refused to come back to the real world.

events.summary: Kamahl kills the death wurm in Topos, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him against Karona.
events.quote: He found the death wurm in Topos and killed it, freeing Ixidor and recruiting him to his cause.

events.summary: Ixidor is possessed by Lowallyn, who is killed by Karona in the final battle, ending Ixidor's life too.
events.quote: Lowallyn was killed in the final battle by Karona, thus also ending the life of Ixidor.
